title: Grateful Dead Live at Baltimore Civic Center on 1982-04-19
lineage: 1st generation Reels (Akai GX-625)> Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1bit/5.6 MHz) > dBpoweramp 24/96 > Adobe Audition CC 2019 > TLH flac2496
source: Dan Healy's Master Soundboard Cassettes (Sony TC-D5M/TDK MA-R90/dolby B)> Frank Streeter's 1st generation 1/4 track Reels @ 3.75 ips (Sony TC770/Maxell UD35-90B)

ai_review.summary: Clear soundboard capture of a fun 1982 Baltimore show with fine playing and classic early‑80s Jerry guitar.
ai_review.review: The three reviewers all give the recording four stars, noting that the set list is strong, the band sounds like they’re having a good time, and Jerry Garcia’s early‑80s tone shines on tracks such as “Tiger.” No technical complaints are made, suggesting the soundboard source delivers clean, listenable audio. Overall it’s an enjoyable snapshot of the Dead in ’82 with solid musicianship.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently positive 4‑star reviews highlight good playing and a pleasant listening experience; the implied soundboard source appears clear, leading to a strong combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No specific issues mentioned; reviewers imply clear, listenable audio typical of a well‑mixed soundboard tape.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Great set list with cohesive flow and enjoyable playing throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Early‑80s guitar tone praised as perfect; vocals noted as thin but improving later in the decade.
